Yeah... Nah. The entire point is to replace humans. Automation replaced labor tasks, and the laborers took on other tasks and managing the automation. AI promises to remove laborers altogether as much as it can. Hence the extreme investment from corporations bent on selling it as a service so employers can shed their workforce. And we're already seeing it. Automation served to eliminate specific tasks and increase productivity. AI is by design attempting to replace humans... that's the point. It wouldn't be worth billions or trillions of dollars if it didn't promise to disrupt the economy so massively. Most of its early uses have mastered entire jobs already.
